# Known issues

What is wrong with the site, not the suite. A test that fails for one of these is doing its job: do
not change the test to make it pass. Report it, and note it here.

## Found by the crawl

### MAJOR SITE-02: 8 broken links: the site links to addresses that answer an error

**Why it matters:** A visitor who follows one of these links reaches an error instead of the page promised.

**Likely fix:** Point each link at a page that exists, or bring the page back (or redirect its old address to where it went).

**In this suite:** the link report (LinkReportTest, links.cy.ts) asks each address again; it fails only on one broken since the crawl.

- /contact-us/: answered 404; linked from /disappearing_elements, /shifting_content/menu
- /status_codes/500: answered 500; linked from /status_codes
- /about/: answered 404; linked from /disappearing_elements, /shifting_content/menu
- /users/3: answered 404; linked from /hovers
- /users/2: answered 404; linked from /hovers
- /users/1: answered 404; linked from /hovers
- /gallery/: answered 404; linked from /shifting_content/menu
- /portfolio/: answered 404; linked from /disappearing_elements, /shifting_content/menu

### MINOR SITE-03: 2 of the site's own links redirect before they arrive

**Why it matters:** Every click on one of these links costs an extra round trip before the page starts loading, and search engines see one page at two addresses.

**Likely fix:** Link to each page's final address (with or without its trailing slash, as the server serves it).

- /notification_message: 302 to /notification_message_rendered
- /redirect: 302 to /status_codes

### MINOR SITE-04: 48 different pages share one title; 34 pages have no title

**Why it matters:** Search results, bookmarks and browser tabs show the title: pages that share one can't be told apart, and a page without one shows its address.

**Likely fix:** Give each page a title of its own that names what it shows (in a single-page app, set it on each route).

- /: titled "The Internet", shows "Welcome to the-internet"
